name: Citizens Energy Group - Citizens Water (Indianapolis)
notes: Researched from public info.citizensenergygroup.com pages (payment options, billing services, payment FAQs, assistance, start/stop/transfer) and the public My Account login, one-time payment and registration pages (no sign-in, no form submitted). My Account login asks for Username and Password (Forgot Password / Forgot UserName / Register Online). Registration asks for the account number and the service address number (the address number cannot be expressed). Payments run through PayNearMe: bank drafts are free and residential card payments are free (commercial customers pay 3.5%, not modelled). Auto Pay drafts the monthly total (or Budget Billing amount) from checking or savings on the due date. Advance payments can be scheduled up to the bill due date (17 days ahead without a current due date; the due-date cap cannot be modelled). Payment arrangements are offered for qualifying customers who are behind, from My Account; stop service for customers leaving the area is an online application processed weekdays within 24 hours. Citizens bills water, wastewater and natural gas together; pay-by-phone is 317-924-3310.

guest_pay.note: Make a one-time bank draft or card payment without signing in; it can also be a gift payment toward someone else's bill.

autopay.note: Auto Pay deducts your total monthly bill, or your Budget Billing amount, from checking or savings on the due date. No fee.

scheduled_payment.note: Advance payments can be scheduled up to your bill due date.

payment_arrangement.note: Qualifying customers who are behind can set up a payment arrangement to avoid disconnection. If your account is in disconnect status, call (317) 924-3311.

cancel_service.note: Use the online Stop Service application if you are leaving the Citizens service area. Orders are processed on weekdays within 24 hours and confirmed by email.

notes: Commercial customers pay a 3.5% service fee on card payments; residential card payments are free.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Pay online from checking or savings with no fee, or with a Visa, Mastercard, Discover or American Express credit or debit card. Card payments are free for residential customers; commercial customers pay a 3.5% service fee. Apple Pay and Google Pay work on a phone.
Pay by phone through the automated line at (317) 924-3310, entering your account number twice. Payments post in real time and show in My Account within about 15 minutes.

Mail one check for all your Citizens services to the bill payment address on your bill, pay cash with a PayNearMe PayCode at stores such as CVS, Family Dollar and Kroger, or use the 24-hour kiosks at 2020 N. Meridian St.
You can schedule a payment ahead of time up to your bill due date.

help.title: Auto Pay
paragraphs: With Auto Pay, your total monthly bill, or your Budget Billing amount, is deducted from your checking or savings account on your due date each month. There is no fee.
Budget Billing evens out seasonal swings by charging about the same amount each month, based on your last 13 months and projected usage, and is reviewed twice a year.

help.title: Paperless Billing
paragraphs: Go paperless and Citizens emails you each month when your bill is ready instead of mailing it. Turn it on from Paperless Billing in My Account.

help.title: Payment arrangements and assistance
paragraphs: Customers who are behind can set up a payment arrangement and avoid disconnection by signing up for flexible payment options. If your account is already in disconnect status and you cannot pay the disconnect amount, call Customer Service at (317) 924-3311.
Partial payments go to the oldest charges first. Citizens also offers Budget Billing, Energy Assistance Program referrals and grants for qualifying customers.

help.title: Stop or transfer service
paragraphs: Use the online application to turn off, turn on or transfer water, wastewater or natural gas service. Customers leaving the Citizens service area choose Stop Service; customers moving within the area choose Transfer.
Electronic orders are processed on weekdays within 24 hours, and you get an email confirmation.

extra.intent: Find the phone number for Citizens' automated pay-by-phone line. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
